intro: From the moment you arrive to the moment you leave, every part of the experience is considered. Explore what makes your stay complete.

cta.description: Choose your room, shape your stay, and let us take care of the details.

stay.title: Stay
stay.label: Rooms & Suites
stay.description: Thoughtfully designed rooms with the comfort, space, and quiet you need to settle in and make the stay your own.

dine.title: Dine
dine.label: Food & Dining
dine.description: Good food, relaxed surroundings, and the freedom to take your time. From your first coffee to your final dinner.

unwind.title: Unwind
unwind.label: Wellness
unwind.description: A quieter side of the stay. Spaces and experiences designed to help you slow down, reset, and enjoy the moment.

gather.title: Gather
gather.label: Events & Meetings
gather.description: Flexible spaces for meetings, celebrations, and everything in between, supported by a team that takes care of the details.
